BombVault 7.11.1 is a small bugfix release: scheduled off-site replication for the Folders domain could silently stop running.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Scheduled off-site replication for Folders could silently stop running.** The off-site replication cadence for a domain could come from two places that were allowed to disagree — the Settings > Schedules field (what the UI shows) and an internal off-site target row's own schedule value (not exposed in the UI, but settable via the off-site-targets API or restored from a settings import). When the target row carried a cadence the Settings field did not, the domain was judged "replicated on its own schedule" and the normal after-backup copy stood down, while no separate scheduled job was ever registered to replace it — the copy fell between the two, with no error and no log line. The Settings column is now the only source ever consulted, matching what actually registers the scheduled job, so the two can no longer disagree. A domain that genuinely does replicate on its own separate schedule now also logs that it skipped the after-backup copy, so a similar gap can't hide silently again. No migration needed — this self-heals on the next scheduled run. (#150)
